svg.title: Repository skyline
svg.desc: 30 repositories as buildings, ranked by commits on the default branch. Building height is commit count, footprint is repo size, and a lit facade means pushed in the last 30 days. 15 occupied, 15 dormant. Tallest is Kairo with 259 commits. Drawn as 4 streets of up to 8, ranked left to right then top to bottom. 11 are private and shown for activity only. 3 further repositories are listed in the table view rather than drawn.
